CC: Forward Pages (iOS)

Quick Reference Guide

| This Quick Reference Guide (QRG) shows how to forward pages in the PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration (CC) Mobile Application for iOS. |
| :---: |

| Forward Pages: In the PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration application, navigate to the main menu. Select Forward Pages. Toggle Forward Pages on to set the end date and time. Select Forward To to select the recipient(s).  NOTE: *If you wish to turn off Forward Pages earlier than the set end date and time, navigate back to Forward Pages and toggle the feature off.*   *![][image1]*  |  |
